frozen: 2026-11-07, before any production change; base commit f3575fb2d00bcce0a5ba9c1cc576d198da0c8c1e
evidence_class: SYNTHETIC regression cases (all exposed; no holdout, no GOLD, no statistics). Not comparable with any earlier case set.
expected_source: Every expected constant is copied from the task spec or hand-derived in hand_arithmetic below; none was computed by the code under test.
adjudication_log: tests/exact20_adjudications.json (append-only, versioned; absent file = no adjudications). This manifest is never edited after freezing; its hash is in tests/exact20_manifest.sha256.

tolerance_policy.why: Expected values are short decimals combined by <=4 multiplications/divisions; float64 accumulates ~1e-15 relative error, so 1e-9 absorbs only binary rounding. Every defect class targeted here (default-to-1, ignored reference quantity, double density, unit slip of 1000x, sign flip, double count) moves the value by >=1e-2 relative, far outside the band.
tolerance_policy.discrete: exit codes, booleans, status/error codes, strings, None/null and list lengths compare exactly
tolerance_policy.accuracy_rate: none claimed; 20 exposed cases cannot support an accuracy rate

status_policy.probe_status: PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN | NOT RUN. UNKNOWN and NOT RUN are never counted as PASS.
status_policy.not_run: surface absent (new API not yet created) or production module not importable; the reason is recorded verbatim
status_policy.declared_probes: op=declared probes emit a fixed UNKNOWN or NOT RUN with a written reason; they are non-blocking and are documentation of an open question, not validation
status_policy.case_status: FAIL if any blocking probe FAILs; else NOT RUN if any blocking probe is NOT RUN; else UNKNOWN if any blocking probe is UNKNOWN; else PASS. Non-blocking members are listed with their own status and never hidden.
status_policy.characterization: kind=characterization asserts CURRENT legacy behaviour (assertion status). A PASS there says nothing about scientific correctness.
status_policy.expected_rejection: a probe whose expected outcome is an explicit rejection PASSes when the rejection happens with the expected code and no numeric result
status_policy.harness_exit: 0 all cases PASS; 1 any case FAIL; 2 no FAIL but some case NOT RUN/UNKNOWN; 3 manifest hash mismatch or harness error
